objectives.text: Find the card with one blue diamond that a tall red house that is 2 tiles from a lamppost is next to.
Find the card with two blue circles that a short green house that is 2 tiles from a tall grey house is beside.
Find the card with one orange circle that a short grey house that is beside a tall grey house is 2 tiles from.
Find the card with two black stars that a short blue house that is next to a short green house is 2 tiles from.
Find the card with two red diamonds that a short yellow house that is 2 tiles from a short grey house is 3 tiles from.
Find the card with two orange stars that a short yellow house that is 4 tiles from a short blue house is 2 tiles from.
Find the card with two green squares that a tall blue house that is beside another tall blue house is beside.
Find the card with two black squares that a short green house that is next to a short yellow house is 2 tiles from.
Find the card with two black hearts that a short green house that is beside a rock is beside.
Find the card with one green plus that a short grey house that is 3 tiles from a short green house is next to.
Find the card with two green circles that a short yellow house that is 2 tiles from a lamppost is next to.
Find the card with one green square that a short yellow house that is beside a tall blue house is next to.
Find the card with one green star that a tall blue house that is beside a short yellow house is next to.
Find the card with two black circles that a rock that is beside another rock is beside.
Find the card with one green heart that a tall grey house that is 2 tiles from a short green house is 2 tiles from.
